tools.name: Game Storage Planner
tools.description: Select your games, pick your SSD size, and instantly see how many games fit on 500GB, 1TB, 2TB, or 4TB. Supports PC, PS5, and Xbox with real 2026 game install sizes.

tools.name: VRAM Calculator for AI/LLMs
tools.description: Find out how much VRAM you need to run Llama, Mistral, Qwen, and other local AI models. Check if your GPU can handle different quantization levels.

tools.name: RAM Latency Calculator
tools.description: Calculate true RAM latency in nanoseconds. Compare DDR4 vs DDR5, different CAS timings, and frequencies. Find out which RAM kit is actually faster for gaming.

tools.name: Resolution Scaling Visualizer
tools.description: See how 1080p, 1440p, and 4K content actually looks on different monitor sizes. Compare pixel density (PPI) and understand resolution scaling before buying a monitor.

tools.name: Budget PC Build Configurator (India)
tools.description: Build the perfect gaming PC for your budget. Select your price range (₹30K to ₹2L), pick your use case, and get component recommendations with India pricing and FPS estimates.

tools.name: PSU Wattage Calculator
tools.description: Calculate exactly how much power your PC build needs. Select your CPU, GPU, and components to get the recommended PSU wattage with headroom and efficiency rating suggestions.
